host: Apple M4 Max, Mac16,5, 14 logical cores, 36 GiB, macOS arm64

notes.cpu_time_seconds: process-wide user+system CPU time diff across the timed region, excluding warmup and model load; avg_cpu_percent exceeds 100 when multiple threads run
notes.input_tokens_per_second: total input tokens across all timed repetitions divided by their total wall time
notes.percentiles: p50 is the median rep total and p95 is the ceil(0.95*n)-1 sample; small rep counts are reported alongside as samples_seconds
notes.request_latency_ms: latency is per request; grouped rows share their request's latency and are not independent timings; includes request construction through answer extraction

timing_scope: request construction, validation, dispatch, and answer extraction; excludes model load (reported per strategy) and result writes; no warmup pass
